classification: Regression from the Cordova iOS 8 compatibility change.
evidence: The original currency implementation in [#705](https://github.com/RevenueCat/cordova-plugin-purchases/pull/705) preserved the optional cache. #920 added `?? [:]`. Executing the unchanged historical method before and after #920 changes an absent cache from `null` to `{}`; the populated-cache control remains `{"all":{}}`.
limitations: Historical method bodies compiled with a nullable result/recording Cordova shim. This isolates the fallback change; full historical Cordova runtime builds were not executed.
